# Boostyou.ai

> WoW Classic leveling and guide site: speed-leveling routes from 1 to 90, all 10 class / 30 spec leveling builds, profession guides for every expansion era, 757 BiS lists, leveling-guide comparisons, and news coverage including World of Warcraft: Forever (Classic+). Updated September 2026. Run by Nutri (YouTube/Twitch content creator). The site partners with RestedXP (affiliate links marked rel="sponsored").

Current game state covered (September 2026):
- WoW Classic Anniversary (TBC): Phase 2 "Overlords of Outland" — Serpentshrine Cavern & Tempest Keep live since May 14, 2026
- Mists of Pandaria Classic: Phase 5 — Siege of Orgrimmar live since June 4, 2026
- World of Warcraft: Forever (Classic+): announced at BlizzCon 2026 on September 12, 2026; beta September 17 to October 21, 2026; launch November 4, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. PST; included with a World of Warcraft subscription or Game Time

## WoW Forever

- [World of Warcraft: Forever, everything announced at BlizzCon 2026](https://boostyou.ai/content/wow-forever.html): Release date and every key date, beta access, the 2026 to 2027 roadmap, zones (Zephras Isle, the Riverglades, Mount Hyjal, Shen'dralas), 9 new dungeons, raids, the Skyborne race, new race and class combinations, every racial compared to Classic, Legacy system perks, profession perks, PvP, Hardcore, editions and prices, FAQ.
- [News: World of Warcraft: Forever announced](https://boostyou.ai/content/news-2026-09-13-world-of-warcraft-forever-announced-classic-plus.html): The BlizzCon 2026 announcement written up as a news article.

Key facts about World of Warcraft: Forever (source: Blizzard, BlizzCon 2026):
- Launch: November 4, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. PST (00:00 CET on November 5). Included with a World of Warcraft subscription or Game Time; no box purchase needed.
- Beta: September 17 to October 21, 2026, playable up to level 30. Access via Skyborne Epic Pack, Warcraft Forever Collection, Collector's Edition, or the opt-in on Blizzard's site.
- Early Name Reservation: October 27 to November 3, 2026, up to 3 characters, with any upgrade edition.
- Level cap 60, permanently; new content keeps coming at 60. No flying mounts, no level scaling. Transmog is opt-in per player; HD and SD graphics can be toggled.
- Skyborne race: requires the Skyborne Heroic Pack (29.99 USD / 29.99 EUR). Alliance High Order Skyborne can be Mage, Horde Windshaper Skyborne can be Shaman; both can be Warrior, Hunter, Rogue and Druid. Starting zone Zephras Isle, levels 1 to 12.
- New race and class combinations confirmed by Blizzard: Undead (Forsaken) Paladin and Dwarf Shaman.
- New zones: Zephras Isle (1-12), the Riverglades (about 30-45, 150+ quests), Shen'dralas (between Mulgore and Desolace), Mount Hyjal (endgame leveling). 1,000+ new quests in total.
- 9 new dungeons: Hall of Thanes (13-18), Lordaeron (15-20), Dalaran (20-35), Excavation Site (Wetlands), The Drowned City (off Stranglethorn Vale), Alcaz Island Prison, The Shaper's Terrace, Krol'Dok Stronghold and Blackmaw Hold (40-60).
- Raids unlock December 9, 2026: Barrow Deeps (10 player, new), Hyjal Summit (20 player, new), Onyxia's Lair (40 player).
- Roadmap: spring 2027 brings 2 new raids (10 and 20 player), 2 dungeons, a new playable area and a legendary questline; summer 2027 brings a revamped iconic raid, a new raid, 2 dungeons and Professions and Legacy updates. PvP seasons refresh in both.
- Systems: account-wide Legacy system (challenges, Legacy Points, a perk tree with Professions, Adventure and Resourcefulness categories, cosmetic reward track), Camping, profession perks, revamped classes and talents, the 15v15 Darkspear Islands battleground, updated Honor system, gamepad support.
- Hardcore is confirmed for Forever.
- Editions: Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack (adds beta, 30 days Game Time, pets, tabards, extra cosmetics), Warcraft Forever Collection (adds Warcraft III: Reforged and Forsaken Kingdom, available until January 11, 2027), and a physical Collector's Edition with a 13-inch Dwarf and Bear statue.

## BiS Lists (PvE Best in Slot)

- [BiS list index](https://boostyou.ai/content/bis-all.html): 757 published lists — per-spec BiS gear with exact drop sources, enchants and gems. Covered so far: Cataclysm p1, Cataclysm p2, Cataclysm p3, Cataclysm preraid, Classic p1, Classic p2, Classic p3, Classic p4, Classic p5, Classic p6, Classic preraid, MoP p1, MoP p2, MoP p3, MoP preraid, TBC p1, TBC p2, TBC p3, TBC p4, TBC p5, TBC preraid, WotLK p1, WotLK p2, WotLK p3, WotLK p4, WotLK preraid. Individual pages: /content/bis-<expansion>-<phase>-<class>-<spec>.html, e.g. /content/bis-mop-p3-warrior-arms.html.
- [Interactive BiS browser](https://boostyou.ai/content/bis.html): same data, pick expansion → phase → class → spec.
- Raw data (JSON, one file per list): https://boostyou.ai/content/bis-data/<expansion>-<phase>-<class>-<spec>.json
